pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into falling knives; incremental volume additions are strictly prohibited until initial position achieves +$10.00 floating profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: ATR-based volatility expansion filter requiring breakout candles to exceed the 20-period average true range by at least 1.5x before execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Implement trailing step-locks; once floating profit hits +$5.00, hard stop locks in at breakeven +$1.00, allowing asymmetry to scale toward +$15.00 to +$30.00 targets.
